A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the noise of TFRs is determined by the properties of resistive material and by the interface between resistive and conducting pastes.

the use of Pb-free resistive and conducting pastes in thick-film resistive technology is possible.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the noise properties of thick-films resistors are determined by the properties of the resistive layer and the properties of the interface layer.
the noise properties of TFRs can be significantly improved by proper choice of resistive and conducting materials.
